source_text: Sicut impleta sunt bona, sic inducet Dominus mala si praevaricati fueritis. Timor salutaris. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: As fulfilled are goods, so will-bring Lord evils if you-shall-have-transgressed. Fear saving. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[Just as the good words were fulfilled, so the Lord will bring evils if you transgress >> Bible:Joshua 23:15]]. Saving fear. Amen.
